Yugoslavia.name: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes

timeline.note: One feature per border period in the source that overlaps the window. ShowFrom and ShowTo are the period cut to the window (for the time slider); BorderFrom and BorderTo are the source's own dates. renamed: a period is cut in two on the day a country's name changed.

changes.note: Land that went from one country to another, cut from the timeline: for each new border, the part another country held the day before (or, where the source leaves a gap of days between holders, the last holder within lookBackDays). Shown for showDays after the change. Changes of name or status inside one country are not changes of hands.
